name: smile/security_advisory_alert
description: Daily check of the installed Composer packages (read from vendor/composer/installed.json, not composer.lock) against OSV / drupal.org security advisories and Drupal PSAs, with an email alert. Works on single sites and multisites (one check and one email per codebase).

suggest.drupal/ultimate_cron: Runs the check at a fixed daily time (a job is provided); without it the check runs on the first cron at least 20 h after the previous one.
